facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note owes the party 975 gold, three-quarters price for their treasure, payable once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not state how much of the note was promised to each, or on what terms.
